title: AI and outbound data destinations
environment: three demo databases: carejiox, carejiox_template, hhh; synthetic isolated tests on codex_vn2026
state: Implemented controls with scoped verification; independent review and remaining actions pending
implemented_controls: Central BI provider guard defaults unknown callers to records, binds patient AI consent to a reviewed destination, refuses remote patient text and disables redirects. Speech uses purpose/recipient gates. Free questions containing undetectable names require an approved local analytics destination.
remaining_actions: Approve actual countries, processor terms, legal bases and destinations. Verify network controls/DNS routing and any providers outside these call paths; no complete all-integration egress claim is made.
limitations: Automated tests and demo evidence establish stated software behavior only. They do not establish every legal obligation, production suitability, authority acceptance or MPS certification.
